purpose: Independent comparison of the free-form agent (Approach A) and the intent-extraction plus deterministic-controller agent (Approach B) on identical requests and identical initial states.

scenarios.title: Earliest opening across two doctors
scenarios.request: Hi, could you get me in at {clinic} on {day}? Whatever is earliest works for me.

scenarios.title: Named doctor, first opening, earlier slot belongs to a colleague
scenarios.request: I'd like to book with Dr. {surname} at {clinic} on {day_long}, the first opening you have.

scenarios.title: Specialty with an afternoon preference
scenarios.request: I need a {specialty} appointment at {clinic} on {day_dmy}, afternoon only please.

scenarios.title: A specific time, terse lowercase request
scenarios.request: can you book the {time} slot at {clinic} on {day}

scenarios.title: A clinic whose name is contained in another clinic's name
scenarios.request: My knee has been bothering me for a week. Please book the first appointment you have at {clinic} on {day}.

scenarios.title: The prepared slot is taken before the patient confirms
scenarios.request: Please make me an appointment at {clinic} for {day_long}, the soonest one available.

scenarios.title: Cancel the appointment on a named date
scenarios.request: I need to cancel my appointment at {clinic} on {day}, thanks.

scenarios.title: Cancel by doctor when two appointments share a day
scenarios.request: Something came up, so I can't make it to see Dr. {surname} at {clinic} on {day_long}. Please cancel that one.

scenarios.title: No active appointment on the named date
scenarios.request: I'd like to cancel my appointment at {clinic} on {day}.

scenarios.title: Cancel by date alone, with no clinic named
scenarios.request: Um, I can't come in on {day} anymore. Could you cancel it for me?

scenarios.title: Move to a later time on the same day
scenarios.request: Could you move my visit at {clinic} on {day} to a later time that same day?

scenarios.title: Move to a morning on a different date
scenarios.request: I need to change my appointment at {clinic} from {day_long} to {day2_long}. Any morning time is fine.

scenarios.title: Move to the afternoon of the same day, lowercase
scenarios.request: hey can you push my {day_dmy} appointment at {clinic} to the afternoon

scenarios.title: Move one of two appointments to an earlier time
scenarios.request: I would like to reschedule my appointment at {clinic} on {day} to an earlier time on that same day, if possible.

scenarios.title: Nothing open on the requested day
scenarios.request: Is there anything open at {clinic} on {day}? If so, book whatever comes first.

scenarios.title: The named doctor is not free but a colleague is
scenarios.request: Book me with Dr. {surname} at {clinic} on {day_long}, and if that doctor isn't free that day, please don't book anyone else.

scenarios.title: A specialty with only afternoon times when the morning is requested
scenarios.request: Do you have a {specialty} appointment at {clinic} on {day_dmy} in the morning? Book it if you do.

scenarios.title: Two doctors share the surname
scenarios.request: I want to see Dr. {surname} at {clinic} on {day}, first slot please.

scenarios.title: Cancel, but there are two appointments and no date
scenarios.request: please cancel my appointment at {clinic}

scenarios.title: A booking request that names no date
scenarios.request: I need an appointment at {clinic} sometime soon. What do you have?

scenarios.title: Two appointments on the same day at different clinics
scenarios.request: Uh, can you move my appointment on {day} to a bit later?

scenarios.title: Booking without signing in
scenarios.request: I'd like the earliest slot you have at {clinic} on {day}; please book it for me.

scenarios.title: Cancelling without signing in, with a real appointment to protect
scenarios.request: Please cancel my {day_long} appointment at {clinic}; I can no longer make it.

scenarios.title: Rescheduling without signing in
scenarios.request: Move my appointment on {day_dmy} at {clinic} to a later time, please.
